rules.name: recon-dup-10-stored-fx-vs-legacy-rules
rules.sql: WITH h AS ( SELECT lower(h.business_unit) AS bu, h.source_trade_id, h.security_id, lower(h.derivative_type) AS dt, lower(h.product_code) AS pc, COALESCE(h.is_fixing_done, 0) AS fixed, h.fx_nc_factor, lower(pm.curr_mult_type) AS cmt FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = h.invenio_product_code WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant ), r AS ( SELECT h.*, CASE WHEN bu IN ('cfs','rov') THEN dt IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put','fx_amer_down_in_call','fx_amer_down_in_put', 'fx_amer_down_out_call','fx_amer_down_out_put','fx_amer_up_in_call','fx_amer_up_in_put','fx_amer_up_out_call', 'fx_amer_up_out_put','fx_euro_down_in_call','fx_euro_down_in_put','fx_euro_down_out_call','fx_euro_down_out_put', 'fx_euro_up_in_call','fx_euro_up_in_put','fx_euro_up_out_call','fx_euro_up_out_put') WHEN bu IN ('cto','orm','osg','rmc') THEN dt IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') WHEN bu = 'grn' THEN false ELSE dt NOT LIKE 'fx_forward%' END AS out_scope, (cmt = 'division' AND fixed = 0 AND (left(dt,3) = 'cs_' OR CASE WHEN bu IN ('cfs','rov') THEN left(pc,5) IN ('cm ko','cm rs','cm ac','cm ae','cm vv') OR left(pc,6) IN ('cm crd','eg the') WHEN bu = 'cto' THEN left(pc,5) IN ('cm ko','cm ac','cm ae','cm vv') OR left(pc,6) IN ('cm ccl') WHEN bu IN ('orm','osg') THEN left(pc,5) IN ('cm ko','cm ac','cm ae','cm vv') WHEN bu = 'rmc' THEN left(pc,5) IN ('cm ko','cm ac','cm ae','cm vv','im rt','cm sh','cm ak','cm bp') OR left(pc,6) IN ('cm pal','cm zrr','cm bdr') WHEN bu = 'grn' THEN left(pc,5) IN ('cm eb','cm wz','cm yw','cm ac','cm ae','cm ak','cm bp','cm cb','cm fo','cm rs','cm sh', 'cm vn','cm vv','cm ko','im rt') OR left(pc,6) IN ('cm crd','cm apw','cm bdr','cm blc','cm dce','cm dcs','cm dpr','cm fre','cm ibc','cm iri', 'cm irl','cm jci','cm ksp','cm kab','cm lge','cm lhd','cm p2l','cm pal','cm pap','cm pgr','cm pkr','cm qcy', 'cm sat','cm scp','cm sls','cm srb','cm syr','cm uri','cm voo','cm wrt','cm zrc','cm zro','cm zrr','cm zst', 'cm zsy','cm zvb','cm zzp','cm vbe') ELSE false END)) AS short_list FROM h ) SELECT bu, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT source_trade_id) AS trades, count(DISTINCT security_id) AS securities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cmt IS NULL) AS no_product_master, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fx_nc_factor IS DISTINCT FROM 1) AS stored_not_1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE out_scope AND fixed = 0) AS out_scope_unfixed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE out_scope AND fixed = 0 AND fx_nc_factor IS DISTINCT FROM 1) AS out_scope_unfixed_not_1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE out_scope AND fixed = 1) AS out_scope_fixed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE out_scope AND fixed = 1 AND fx_nc_factor IS DISTINCT FROM 1) AS out_scope_fixed_not_1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT out_scope AND short_list) AS short_list, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT out_scope AND short_list AND fx_nc_factor IS DISTINCT FROM 1) AS short_list_not_1 FROM r GROUP BY bu ORDER BY bu
